perks.summary: With a Throwing-skill weapon wielded (javelin, throwing axe/knife, stone, sling) the troop's ReloadSpeed is raised by 20%, i.e. it readies the next throw faster.

perks.rbm: RBMCombat's SetAiRelatedProperties reload postfix assigns ReloadSpeed only for bow/long_bow/crossbow_fast/crossbow usages, so throwing ReloadSpeed is untouched (RangedRework.Reload.cs:35, :96-114). RBMAI only multiplies it by stamina (AgentStats.cs:321). How the engine uses ReloadSpeed for throwing weapons is native code (not verifiable here).
